class.name: AttributeModifier
class.brief_description: One attribute change carried by a [GameplayEffect].
class.description: Applies [code]ADD[/code], [code]MULTIPLY[/code] or [code]OVERRIDE[/code] to a named attribute. See [AttributeSet] for how the operations combine.

method.name: apply
method.description: Applies this modifier to [param input_value] alone. [AbilitySystemComponent] combines every active modifier instead; this is for computing a preview.

members.member: The attribute this modifier changes, by name.
The amount. What it means depends on [member operation]: an addend, a factor, or the value itself.
How [member magnitude] is combined with the attribute's value.

constants.constant: Added to the running value. Every [constant ADD] on an attribute is summed.
Multiplied into the running value, after every [constant ADD] has been summed.
Replaces the value outright. A single [constant OVERRIDE] beats every [constant ADD] and [constant MULTIPLY] on that attribute.
